$comment: Single source of truth for committed agent evals. Adding an eval = create workers/main/tests/evals/<id>.test.ts (gated on RUN_AGENT_EVALS, ending in emitEvalTranscript from ./eval-transcript) and add one entry here. Consumed by scripts/run-agent-eval.mjs, scripts/run-eval-suite.sh, and the eval control plane (GET /api/evals). custom-prompt-live is intentionally NOT listed — it's the generic env-driven custom-prompt harness, not a fixed eval. realDeploy:true marks evals that only run when real deploy is enabled (CF_API_TOKEN + EVAL_REAL_DEPLOY!=0).

evals.description: Build a polished static HTML dashboard from fake business data
Scaffold + deploy a Cloudflare Worker app to the testing-grounds namespace
Build and deploy a persistent space themed matching game with leaderboard
Write and verify a file in the project sandbox
Create a scheduled prompt and verify it persisted (exercises the lean-dropped schedules tools via discovery)
Create a deterministic workflow and verify it persisted (exercises the lean-dropped workflows tools via discovery)
Create a remote MCP integration and verify it persisted (exercises the lean-dropped integrations tools via discovery)
Discover and call the custom-domain diagnostics tool (exercises the lean-dropped domains tools via discovery)
Discover and call the warehouse connection listing tool (exercises the lean-dropped warehouse/connections tools via discovery)
